question: The mean and the mode of a set of data are 53.1 and 14.1, respectively. Find the median of the data, using the empirical formula.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the empirical relationship formula directly:

Median = (Mode + 2 × Mean) ÷ 3

Median = (14.1 + 2 × 53.1) ÷ 3

Median = (14.1 + 106.2) ÷ 3

Median = 120.3 ÷ 3 = 40.1

**∴ The correct answer is 40.1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Empirical Relationship: Mode, Median, Mean
 Median divides distance between Mode and Mean in 2:1 ratio

**Given:**

Mean of the data = 53.1

Mode of the data = 14.1

**Formula Used:**

The empirical formula relating the three central tendencies is given by:

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

**Calculations:**

⇒ 14.1 = 3 × Median − 2 × 53.1

⇒ 14.1 = 3 × Median − 106.2

⇒ 3 × Median = 14.1 + 106.2

⇒ 3 × Median = 120.3

⇒ Median = 120.3 ÷ 3

⇒ Median = 40.1

**∴ The correct answer is 40.1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For moderately skewed distributions, the difference between the mean and the mode is approximately three times the difference between the mean and the median. This provides the rule: Mean − Mode = 3 × (Mean − Median).

Mean

The sum of all given observations divided by the total number of observations. It is highly sensitive to extreme values or outliers in the data.

Median

The exact middle value of a sorted dataset. It divides the data into two equal halves and remains unaffected by abnormal extremes or outliers.

Mode

The most frequently occurring value in a dataset. A given dataset can have one mode, multiple modes, or no mode at all if all values appear equally.
